title: Amazon DynamoDB to Amazon Kinesis
description: Deploy a DynamoDB table that uses a Kinesis stream

introBox.headline: How it works
text: The CDK stack deploys a DynamoDB table and a Kinesis Data Stream.
When new items are added to the DynamoDB table, the item-level changes in the table will be streamed to the Kinesis Data Stream.

bullets.text: Creating a single-table design with Amazon DynamoDB
Building serverless applications with streaming data: Part 1

testing.headline: Testing
text: After deployment, add an item to the DynamoDB table. Go to the CloudWatch Metrics for the deployed Kinesis Data Stream. You will see incoming record metrics for the item data.
